title: Privacy Policy
html:
FOOD TRUCK CENTRE (FTC)

Privacy Policy

  1. Overview

FTC is committed to protecting personal information in accordance with the Privacy Act 1988 and the Australian Privacy Principles.

  1. Information We Collect

We may collect:

  • Name, email address, and phone number
  • Business details (including ABN)
  • Payment and transaction information
  • Event and booking details
  • Website usage data (cookies, analytics)

  1. How We Use Information

We use personal information to:

  • Provide and operate the Platform
  • Facilitate bookings between Organisers and Vendors
  • Process payments, if required, and commissions
  • Communicate with users
  • Improve our services

  1. Disclosure of Information

We may disclose information:

  • Between Organisers and Vendors to facilitate bookings
  • To service providers (e.g. payment processors, IT providers)
  • Where required by law

We do not sell personal information to third parties.

  1. Data Security

We take reasonable steps to protect personal information from misuse, loss, and unauthorised access. However, no system is completely secure.

  1. Access and Correction

Users may request access to or correction of their personal information by contacting FTC.

  1. Cookies and Tracking

The Platform may use cookies and analytics tools to improve user experience and performance.

  1. Contact

Privacy enquiries can be directed to: info@foodtruckcentre.com.au
